commit.message:
fix(eval): score RE1 disk faults against latency, which RE1 telemetry actually carries

RE1 cases were recorded before container blkio was added to the collector, so
they have no <service>_diskio column and the metric-level disk ground truth was
unreachable. Use latency for RE1 datasets (as in the original evaluation) and
keep diskio for RE2 onward. Closes #77.

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Hrson9R3vX1C9TwDAETFfy
